_readme: DE-08 Cost & Optimization Agent config. Estimates and optimizes cloud and infrastructure costs based on tech stack choices and usage projections.

agent.name: Cost & Optimization Agent
agent.description: Accepts structured requirements and architecture context to produce Total Cost of Ownership estimates and prioritized optimization recommendations.

behaviour._blocking_note: Cost line items or optimization recommendations produced with low confidence are flagged as blocking — must be reviewed before downstream agents (e.g. Design Review, FinOps) consume the estimates.

agent_network_html.description: Raw HTML content of the agent-network / business-process diagram. Drives per-service cost estimation — extract services, data stores, external integrations, and communication patterns from the embedded diagram and surrounding markup.

cost_estimate.description: Total Cost of Ownership breakdown by service and cost category, with monthly and annual projections.

line_items.category: compute | storage | network | third_party | licensing | managed_services
line_items.rationale: string — why this cost exists and how it was estimated

assumptions: string — key assumptions behind the estimates

optimization_plan.description: Prioritized list of cost optimization recommendations with estimated savings.

item_schema.title: string
item_schema.category: reservation | right_sizing | autoscaling | architecture_change | tier_optimization | elimination
item_schema.estimated_savings_pct: number — percentage reduction on affected line items
item_schema.trade_off: string — what you give up for the savings

cost_modeling.description: Builds per-service cost models from structured_requirements usage hints and service topology from agent_network_html. Estimates compute, storage, network, and third-party costs.

resource_optimization.description: Identifies right-sizing opportunities, reserved instance commitments, autoscaling strategies, and architectural simplifications that reduce cost without degrading service quality.

finops_awareness.description: Applies FinOps principles — cost allocation tagging, showback/chargeback structures, budget alerting thresholds, and unit economics per service.

cost_calculator.description: Estimates per-service monthly/annual cloud costs based on usage projections from structured_requirements and service topology from agent_network_html.

sizing_advisor.description: Recommends instance types, storage tiers, and capacity reservations based on throughput/latency requirements and data volume estimates.

finops_dashboard.description: Structures cost data into FinOps-ready outputs — tagging strategies, budget thresholds, cost anomaly alerting rules per service.

git_reader._enabled_note: false -> read from local files under tech_stack.git_reader.local_audit_dir. true -> read from the real audit repo via GitPython. Toggle per environment.
git_reader._note: run_id is passed by GenWiz as X-Run-ID header on every agent call. Agent uses it to resolve the path and read previous step output.

dev._note: Used only when ENV=dev AND enabled=true. phase_input_fixture replaces an empty HTTP body. git_input_fixtures override the git/local fetch for the listed fields. phase_input_text_files load raw text files (HTML/MD/TXT) into the listed payload fields. In prod (ENV=prod) this whole block is ignored.
